segments.spoken_text: Your first AI project might fit on one sticky note.
Pick something your team repeats. For this example, turning weekly notes into a draft update.
Write down what goes in, what should come out, and who checks it.
Give AI the drafting step. Keep the decision about what to send with a person.
Now try one made-up example. Include a missing detail and see how the draft handles it.
If it guesses, change the instruction: mark the gap instead of filling it.
That gives you a small test you can inspect before connecting real work.
Take one repeated task. Name its input, its output, and the person responsible.

selection_basis: Clear audience task and production simplicity; no empirical winner claim
